decision: Stock legacy clients with an actual surrounding-text boundary use the existing ordinary ManagedCommit input; explicit exact-refresh clients keep their owned preedit.
reason: LibreOffice GTK3 v49 reproduced an underlined typed prefix and supplied ten real SetSurroundingText callbacks. This qualifies the existing ordinary-input path for that mechanism. Opaque Chrome did not supply such callbacks and is not covered.
verification: v55 source26/26 and452/452 PASS; build and engine-only install verified. Actual LibreOffice functional5PASS/1FAIL, prefix presentationFAIL in both positions. Native delayed initial SSI disproves applicability of the pre-snapshot fixture. Receipt libreoffice-presentation-probe-v55/result.json; protected runtime and seven restorations verified.
not_tested: No full browser matrix or GNOME rerun; Chrome plain prefix unresolved; no accessibility provider adopted.
consequences: One existing input-mode predicate changes. No new owner, input/output transport, executor, fake surrounding snapshot or client-name branch. Preserve managed_commit_snapshot_floor, exact_managed_surrounding_word_is_current, focus/selection/privacy guards and verifier. Missing snapshots keep the opaque-client owned-preedit path. Native LibreOffice acceptance must include hint/Tab, word-boundary correction, physical Shift and Double Shift; retain Kitty/Chrome controls. Reject if ordinary typing is lost or authority guards regress.
